newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Smartflex Q4 view cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Smartflex Q4 view cut.

text.p: -- Madison Securities Inc on Tuesday said it trimmed its fourth-quarter earnings estimate for Smartflex Systems Inc to $0.31 a share from $0.32.
-- The firm said it reduced its estimate because of limited availablity of certain component parts needed in the company's Chip-on-Ceramic manufacturing process.
-- "Without these constraints, which should not continue in Q1 1997, Smartflex would have matched or exceeded our original EPS estimates," analyst Jeffrey Maxick noted in a report.
--Madison Securities said it raised its 1997 EPS estimates to $1.46 from $1.41 and its sales projections to $186.9 million from $178.0 million.

--It said it was optimistic about the company's performance this year because of the expected success of new process technologies, continued market development, expansion and demand for its technologically advanced products and improved margins.
--Smartflex shares rose 1/8 to 16-1/8 in Nasdaq trading on Tuesday.
